[[/hcell]] [[hcell colspan="3"]] Redran [[/hcell]] [[/row]] [[row]] [[cell colspan="3"]] A long-range pet that can tear multi-part enemies, such as Ragne and Vibras, quickly. On the reverse side, they also can tear down Redran quickly. Redran has the highest Pwr among all pets, but also the lowest Def of all pets, with about 120 HP less than Synchro and only 60 DEF better.

Redran, along with Sally and Popple, can jam. Pressing a PA button at the same time when they lose target will cause them to skip the said PA, but will still cost PP. Mind the timing between PAs.

I believe Redran is a portmanteau of Laser Dragon (レーザードラゴン), thus their name should be Ladran (read: leɪdræn). Would be too difficult to read, though.

Redran has minimal use on EQ outside seasonal, defense, and endless quests; especially because they tend to run out of PP quickly. In addition, Redran is hard-pressed to secure the number of kills it needed in UH fields, further hampering its usage. [[/cell]] [[/row]]

Personality Description
[[image http:capa.wdfiles.com/local--files/guide:phantasy-star-online-2-summoner/Personality.png class="pet-personality"]] Rambunctious (あばれんぼう Rowdy//) Raises damage by 2% for each enemy killed by Redran; capped at 50% or 150% damage total. The bonus will be reset upon entering campship and unsummoning Redran. This would be the preferred personality.
[[image http:capa.wdfiles.com/local--files/guide:phantasy-star-online-2-summoner/Personality.png class="pet-personality"]] Belligerent (とうそうしん Hawkish//) Raises damage depending on number of enemies near the Redran. 106% for 1-4 enemies, 112% for 5 enemies and above. Since Redran is a long-range pet that has a low durability, this skill becomes counterproductive for its survival, specially since it does not do much in boss EQs.
[[image http://capa.wdfiles.com/local--files/guide:phantasy-star-online-2-summoner/Personality.png class="pet-personality"]] Rock (ロック) ★14 only. Combines Rambunctious and Belligerent, as well as having increased rare item drop rate.

[[table class="wiki-content-table border-top-none border-bottom-none"]] [[row]] [[hcell class="border-top-none"]] Strength [[/hcell]] [[hcell class="border-top-none"]] Weakness [[/hcell]] [[/row]] [[row]] [[cell class="pros-cons-list pros w-50 border-bottom-none"]]

  • Highest possible damage multiplier (150%) from personality
  • Decimates enemy with multiple parts quickly
  • High-powered normal attacks
  • High Pwr
  • Recall attack has invulnerability frames

[[/cell]] [[cell class="pros-cons-list cons w-50 border-bottom-none"]]

  • Unsuitable for newbies
  • Prone to jamming
  • Beside recall, all other attacks are slow
  • Low HP
  • Low Def
  • Not much use against bosses that don't have multiple parts
  • Little use during Boss EQ

1 DPS: Damage Per Second, the higher the better.
2 Normal Attack DPS Rating: The DPS rating of Normal Attacks. Hold is the DPS if you hold the normal attack button. Auto is the number if you let the pet attack freely. If only Hold exists, then the pet will do less if you don't hold the button. The number in bracket is the restored PP per second, disregarding natural PP regen.
3 Overall DPS Rating: The greater the number, the greater the pet's DPS potential is. This is calculated by using Glance of Darkness with Rykros Staff +30, during standard case scenario: Phantom sub, enemy is weak to pet's element, enemy isn't moving, a pair of 110% damage parfaits, using PA to deplete 200PP, then use Normal Attacks to get back 200PP (boosted natural PP regen and attack PP regen due to Phantom sub is calculated).
4 Sweets in bold are currently what Manaka put on her pets. For more information about Sweets, see the [#recommended-candies Recommended Sweets] Section.

  • Try using Mine-Gravity-Mine-Gravity.
